title: How to Reform US Long-term Care
title_zh: 如何改革美国长期护理制度
title_primary: 如何改革美国长期护理制度
title_secondary: How to Reform US Long-term Care
authors: Braun, R. Anton, Kopecky, Karen A.
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Long-term care is costly. About 45 percent of 65-year-old Americans will require formal long-term care assistance during their lifetime and one in twelve will incur out-of-pocket expenses of $200,000 or more. Surprisingly, only 10 percent of retirees have private long-term care insurance. We use a quantitative structural model to show that an obstacle to increasing coverage is disagreement across the income distribution: scaling back Medicaid expands the private market and benefits the affluent but imposes large welfare losses on the poor, while universal public insurance does the opposite. We then show that making Medicaid the primary rather than the secondary payer of longterm care costs, while retaining its means tests, raises welfare for nearly all Americans. Private insurers respond by offering smaller, more profitable policies, and total coverage against long-term care risk rises with only a modest increase in public expenditures.
abstract_zh: 长期护理成本高昂。约45%的65岁美国人在其一生中将需要正式的长期护理援助，且每12人中就有1人将承担20万美元或以上的自付费用。令人惊讶的是，仅有10%的退休人员拥有私人长期护理保险。我们运用定量结构模型表明，扩大覆盖面的一个障碍在于收入分配上的分歧：缩减医疗补助计划会扩大私人市场并惠及富裕群体，但会给贫困群体带来巨大的福利损失，而全民公共保险则效果相反。随后，我们证明，若将医疗补助计划作为长期护理费用的主要支付方而非次要支付方，同时保留其经济状况调查，则几乎能提升所有美国人的福利。私人保险公司会相应提供更小但利润更高的保单，针对长期护理风险的总体保障水平将上升，而公共支出仅需适度增加。

title: Protecting Employees or Replacing Them? Paid Sick Leave Mandates and Firm Automation
title_zh: 保护员工还是替代员工？带薪病假规定与企业自动化
title_primary: 保护员工还是替代员工？带薪病假规定与企业自动化
title_secondary: Protecting Employees or Replacing Them? Paid Sick Leave Mandates and Firm Automation
authors: Zhihan Shen, Wenhui Huang
abstract: Paid sick leave mandates aim to improve employee benefits. This paper examines how firms respond to the additional labor costs caused by PSL mandates. Leveraging the staggered implementation of PSL mandates across U.S. states, we use a difference-in-differences design and find that mandatory PSLs greatly accelerate firms’ adoption of automation. This effect is particularly evident among labor-intensive firms, consistent with the view that rising employment costs drive labor-capital substitution. Overall, by revealing an unintended consequence of PSL mandates, this study contributes to the pertinent literature and has important policy implications.
abstract_zh: 带薪病假（PSL）强制规定旨在改善员工福利。本文探讨了企业如何应对由PSL强制规定带来的额外劳动成本。利用美国各州分阶段实施PSL强制规定的自然实验，我们采用双重差分设计，发现强制性PSL显著加速了企业采用自动化技术的进程。这一效应在劳动密集型企业中尤为明显，与就业成本上升驱动劳动-资本替代的观点相符。总体而言，通过揭示PSL强制规定的意外后果，本研究为相关文献做出了贡献，并具有重要的政策启示。

title: DP19807 Article-level Slant and Polarization of News Consumption on Social Media
title_zh: 社交媒体新闻消费的文章级倾向与极化研究
title_primary: 社交媒体新闻消费的文章级倾向与极化研究
title_secondary: DP19807 Article-level Slant and Polarization of News Consumption on Social Media
authors: Luca Braghieri, Sarah Eichmeyer, Ro'ee Levy, Markus Mobius, Jacob Steinhardt 等
official: 官方在线 2024-12-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We fine-tune a large language model on expert ratings to construct a content-based, article-level measure of news slant, applied to the near universe of articles (∼1 million) published online by the top ∼100 U.S. outlets in 2019. 70% of the variation in slant occurs within rather than across outlets, leaving wide scope for within-outlet ideological selection. Consistent with this, polarization in news consumption on Facebook—the gap in average slant between articles Republicans and Democrats consume—equals 89% of the distance between the average New York Times and Fox News article and is 53% larger than outlet-level measures imply.
abstract_zh: 我们基于专家评分对大型语言模型进行微调，构建了一个基于内容、文章层面的新闻倾向度量指标，并将其应用于2019年美国前约100家媒体在线发布的近全部文章（约100万篇）。倾向性变异的70%发生在媒体内部而非媒体之间，这为媒体内部的意识形态选择留下了广阔空间。与此一致的是，Facebook上新闻消费的两极分化——共和党人与民主党人所消费文章的平均倾向差距——相当于《纽约时报》与福克斯新闻平均文章之间差距的89%，且比媒体层面度量所暗示的差距大53%。

title: Should I wait or should I pay? The dynamics of private and public healthcare
title_zh: 我应该等待还是支付？私人与公共医疗的动态
title_primary: 我应该等待还是支付？私人与公共医疗的动态
title_secondary: Should I wait or should I pay? The dynamics of private and public healthcare
authors: Denis Caporale, Francesco Magris, Gabriele Sbaiz, Bianca Tanasa
abstract: In many countries, a private health system coexists with the public one. However, the latter is increasingly subject to budgetary cuts and no longer able to meet healthcare demand. Within an O L G model in which young agents, beside in capital, invest also in health, we show that access to the public health system is rationed by increasing waiting times, entailing costs in terms of treatment effectiveness and psychological order. Considering a fiscal policy aimed at providing health services and stabilizing public debt-to- G D P , we obtain two equilibrium regimes, the first one emerging for low G D P levels, the other for larger ones. By performing a global analysis, we find a lower globally unstable stationary solution and a higher globally stable one, and waiting times to be counter-cyclical along the transitional path. We also characterize the set of optimal allocations and prove that G D P is increasing in the social discount factor. Finally, we show how to decentralize any optimal allocation by fixing opportunely the debt-to-capital ratio and public healthcare provision.
abstract_zh: 在许多国家，私人医疗体系与公共医疗体系并存。然而，后者日益面临预算削减，已无法满足医疗需求。在一个OLG模型中，年轻一代除了投资于资本外，还投资于健康，我们展示了公共医疗体系的准入因等待时间增加而受到限制，这带来了治疗有效性和心理秩序方面的成本。考虑一项旨在提供医疗服务并稳定公共债务与GDP比率的财政政策，我们得到了两种均衡状态，第一种出现在低GDP水平时，第二种则出现在较高GDP水平时。通过进行全局分析，我们发现了一个全局不稳定的较低稳态解和一个全局稳定的较高稳态解，并且等待时间在过渡路径上呈逆周期特征。我们还刻画了最优配置的集合，并证明了GDP随社会贴现因子增加而增加。最后，我们展示了如何通过适当设定债务资本比率和公共医疗供给来分散任何最优配置。

title: Geographical Accessibility to Gambling Venues and Suicide
title_zh: 赌博场所的地理可达性与自杀
title_primary: 赌博场所的地理可达性与自杀
title_secondary: Geographical Accessibility to Gambling Venues and Suicide
authors: Cameron, Lachlan, Black, Nicole, Johnston, David, Pirkis, Jane, Ride, Jemimah 等
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Worldwide, gambling can cause economic and health-related harm to individuals and communities. Policy responses to reduce these harms require evidence on the effects of features of the gambling environment. This study explores whether geographical accessibility to gambling venues impacts suicides. We construct a longitudinal spatial data set with information on the number of gambling venues and suicides in Australian neighbourhoods from 2001 to 2018, and exploit changes in accessibility induced by venue openings and closures. The closure of a gambling venue is estimated to decrease the number of suicides per year in that area by 9.8%. Effects of gambling venues in neighbouring areas are small and statistically insignificant, indicating that the relationship between venue access and suicide is concentrated close to the venue location.
abstract_zh: 在全球范围内，赌博可能对个人和社区造成经济与健康方面的伤害。为减少这些伤害而制定的政策应对措施，需要基于赌博环境特征影响效应的证据。本研究探讨了赌博场所的地理可及性是否影响自杀行为。我们构建了一个纵向空间数据集，包含2001年至2018年间澳大利亚社区赌博场所数量及自杀情况的信息，并利用场所开业与关闭所引发的可及性变化进行分析。据估计，赌博场所的关闭可使该地区每年的自杀人数减少9.8%。邻近地区赌博场所的影响效应较小且统计上不显著，这表明赌博场所可及性与自杀之间的关系主要集中在场所位置附近。

title: Optimal Age-based Policies for Pandemics: An Economic Analysis of Covid-19 and Beyond
title_zh: 疫情最优年龄分层政策：基于新冠疫情及未来的经济学分析
title_primary: 疫情最优年龄分层政策：基于新冠疫情及未来的经济学分析
title_secondary: Optimal Age-based Policies for Pandemics: An Economic Analysis of Covid-19 and Beyond
authors: Luiz Brotherhood, Philipp Kircher, Cezar Santos, Michèle Tertilt
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-31 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper investigates the importance of the age composition for pandemic policy design. To do so, it introduces an economic framework with age heterogeneity, individual choice, and incomplete information, emphasizing the value of testing. Calibrating the model to the US Covid-19 pandemic reveals an 80% reduction in the death toll due to voluntary actions and the lockdown implemented in the US. The optimal lockdown, however, is more stringent than what was implemented. Moreover, the social planner follows an asymmetric approach by locking down the young relatively more than the old. We highlight the role of testing in reducing deaths, lowering economic costs, and allowing for a less restrictive lockdown. A social planner would choose a faster ramp-up in testing capacity relative to what occurred in the US. We use the framework to provide insights into pandemics caused by different viruses (including the Spanish flu), and underline the influence of economic conditions on optimal policies.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了年龄结构在疫情政策设计中的重要性。为此，引入了一个包含年龄异质性、个体选择及信息不完全的经济框架，并强调了检测的价值。通过将模型校准至美国新冠疫情数据，发现自愿行动与美国实施的封锁措施使死亡人数减少了80%。

title: DP5019 Stochastic Optimization and Worst Case Analysis in Monetary Policy Design
title_zh: 货币政策设计中的随机优化与最坏情况分析
title_primary: 货币政策设计中的随机优化与最坏情况分析
title_secondary: DP5019 Stochastic Optimization and Worst Case Analysis in Monetary Policy Design
authors: Berc Rustem, Volker Wieland, Stan Zakovic
official: 官方在线 2005-04-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In this paper we compare expected loss minimization to worst-case or minimax analysis in the design of simple Taylor-style rules for monetary policy using a small model estimated for the euro area by Orphanides and Wieland (2000). We find that rules optimized under a minimax objective in the presence of general parameter and shock uncertainty do not imply extreme policy activism. Such rules tend to obey the Brainard principle of cautionary policy-making in much the same way as rules derived by expected loss minimization. Rules derived by means of minimax analysis are effective insurance policies limiting maximum loss over ranges of parameter values to be set by the policy-maker. In practice, we propose to set these ranges with an eye towards the cost of such insurance cover in terms of the implied increase in expected inflation variability.
abstract_zh: 本文通过奥法尼德斯和维兰德（2000）估算的欧元区小型模型，比较了简单泰勒规则货币政策设计中预期损失最小化与最坏情况（即极小化极大分析）两种方法。研究发现，在存在一般参数和冲击不确定性的情况下，基于极小化极大目标优化的规则并不会导致极端的政策激进性。这类规则倾向于遵循布雷纳德审慎决策原则，其方式与通过预期损失最小化推导的规则高度相似。通过极小化极大分析推导的规则是有效的保险策略，能够将政策制定者设定的参数区间内的最大损失限制在可控范围内。在实践中，我们建议根据此类保险覆盖的成本（以隐含的预期通胀波动性增加来衡量）来设定这些参数区间。

title: On the development strategy of countries of intermediate size - An analysis of heterogenous firms in a multiregion framework
title_zh: 中等规模国家发展战略研究——基于多区域框架下的异质性企业分析
title_primary: 中等规模国家发展战略研究——基于多区域框架下的异质性企业分析
title_secondary: On the development strategy of countries of intermediate size - An analysis of heterogenous firms in a multiregion framework
authors: Rikard Forslid, Toshihiro Okubo, Yujiang River Chen, Coen Teulings, Steven Davis 等
official: 官方在线 2011-01-03 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper compares two policies: trade cost reduction and firm relocation cost reduction using a three-country version of a heterogeneous-firms economic geography model, where the three countries have different market (population) size. We show how the effects of the two policies differ, in particular, for the country of intermediate size. Unless the intermediate country is very small, it will gain industry when relocation costs are reduced, but lose industry when trade costs are reduced. The smallest country loses industry in both cases, but only experiences lower welfare in the case of lower relocation costs. Thus, the ranking of the policies from the point of view of the two small and intermediate countries tends to be the opposite.
abstract_zh: 本文通过构建一个包含三个国家的异质性企业经济地理模型，比较了贸易成本降低与企业迁移成本降低两种政策的效果。其中，三个国家具有不同的市场规模（人口规模）。我们揭示了这两种政策效应的差异，尤其聚焦于中等规模国家。除非中等规模国家非常小，否则当迁移成本降低时，该国将获得产业增长；而当贸易成本降低时，该国将面临产业流失。最小规模国家在两种情形下均会失去产业，但仅在迁移成本降低时遭遇福利下降。因此，从两个小国和中等规模国家的视角来看，两种政策的优劣排序往往呈现相反趋势。

title: From Grants to Loans: Mental Health and Adaptive Responses to the 2015 Dutch Student Finance Reform
title_zh: 从补助到贷款：2015年荷兰学生资助改革中的心理健康与适应性应对
title_primary: 从补助到贷款：2015年荷兰学生资助改革中的心理健康与适应性应对
title_secondary: From Grants to Loans: Mental Health and Adaptive Responses to the 2015 Dutch Student Finance Reform
authors: Nursena Aksunger (Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam), Wendy Janssens (Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam), Menno Pradhan (Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam)
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines the causal relationship between student debt and mental health using the 2015 Dutch student finance reform as a natural experiment. The reform replaced a universal grant with income-contingent loans for higher-education students, leaving vocational students unaffected and serving as a natural comparison group. Low-income students were partly compensated through expanded targeted support. Using nationwide administrative data from Statistics Netherlands, we implement a difference-in-differences design comparing clinically diagnosed depression, anxiety, and broader mental health outcomes between higher education and vocational education students before and after the reform. We find no evidence of adverse mental health effects from the transition to debt-based financing. At the same time, students adjusted their behaviour by marginally increasing labour earnings and remaining longer in co-residence with their parents. These findings suggest that behavioural responses to the reform may have mitigated financial strain, although lenient repayment terms likely also cushioned the impact of the reform. Overall, the results indicate that the mental health impact of student debt may depend not only on financial exposure but also on institutional context and individuals' ability to adjust.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2015年荷兰学生资助改革作为自然实验，考察学生债务与心理健康之间的因果关系。该改革将高等教育学生的普遍性助学金替换为按收入比例偿还的贷款，而职业教育学生未受影响，作为自然对照组。低收入学生通过扩大定向支持得到部分补偿。利用荷兰统计局的全国行政数据，我们采用双重差分设计，比较改革前后高等教育与职业教育学生在临床诊断的抑郁症、焦虑症及更广泛心理健康结果上的差异。研究发现，转向债务型资助并未对心理健康产生不利影响的证据。同时，学生通过略微增加劳动收入并延长与父母同住的时间来调整自身行为。这些发现表明，对改革的应对行为可能缓解了经济压力，尽管宽松的还款条款也可能缓冲了改革的影响。总体而言，结果表明学生债务对心理健康的影响不仅取决于经济暴露程度，还取决于制度环境及个体的适应能力。

title: Payment for environmental services in Brazil: A systematic scoping review of policy design, governance, and territorial patterns
title_zh: 巴西环境服务付费：政策设计、治理与地域格局的系统性范围综述
title_primary: 巴西环境服务付费：政策设计、治理与地域格局的系统性范围综述
title_secondary: Payment for environmental services in Brazil: A systematic scoping review of policy design, governance, and territorial patterns
authors: Manoel Martins da Costa Junior, Vanessa Batista Schramm, Fernando Schramm
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Brazil established its National Policy of Payment for Environmental Services (PES) to promote the maintenance, recovery, and enhancement of ecosystems. Yet the diversity, spatial distribution, and effectiveness of existing initiatives remain poorly understood. This study provides the first nationwide synthesis of all PES programs implemented in Brazil since 2000, based on a systematic scoping review of 80 peer-reviewed papers documenting 138 distinct programs. We apply an analytical framework with 11 dimensions to classify and compare programs by ecosystem type, service category, funding source, objectives, and governance mechanisms. Results show initiatives concentrate in the Atlantic Forest (49.3%) and Cerrado (23.2%) biomes, largely targeting regulation services (93.2%) via forest conservation (65.2%) and restoration (61.6%) actions. Watershed (73.9%) and Forest & Carbon (14.8%) programs predominate; 59.4% of initiatives are in Southeast and 17.4% in North. Most programs rely on public funding (94%), while private and market-based mechanisms remain rare. Despite frequent social objectives (65%) and non-monetary benefits (35%), fiscal dependence and regional imbalance constrain scalability and policy sustainability. By comparing Brazil’s experience with international trends in PES governance, we identify structural challenges to design more adaptive, inclusive, and financially diversified mechanisms that strengthen ecosystem protection and social equity across biomes. Explicitly contrasting Brazil with Latin – American benchmarks, we show that – unlike Costa Rica’s centralized national PES and Mexico’s federally coordinated watershed schemes – Brazil’s policy has fostered a decentralized mosaic of municipal and state programs, closely linked to Forest Code compliance and frequent mixed (cash and in-kind) payments, outlining a distinct regional governance model.
abstract_zh: 巴西建立了国家生态系统服务付费政策，旨在促进生态系统的维护、恢复与增强。然而，现有举措的多样性、空间分布及有效性仍缺乏充分认知。本研究基于对80篇同行评审论文的系统性范围综述（涵盖138个独立项目），首次对2000年以来巴西实施的所有生态系统服务付费项目进行全国性综合梳理。我们运用包含11个维度的分析框架，从生态系统类型、服务类别、资金来源、目标及治理机制等方面对项目进行分类比较。结果显示：项目集中于大西洋森林（49.3%）和塞拉多（23.2%）生物群落，主要通过森林保护（65.2%）和恢复（61.6%）行动瞄准调节服务（93.2%）；流域项目（73.9%）与森林碳汇项目（14.8%）占主导地位；59.4%的举措分布在东南部，17.4%在北部。多数项目依赖公共资金（94%），私营和市场机制仍属罕见。尽管频繁设定社会目标（65%）并提供非货币收益（35%），财政依赖性与区域失衡制约了可扩展性与政策可持续性。通过将巴西经验与国际生态系统服务付费治理趋势对比，我们识别出设计更具适应性、包容性和财务多元化机制的结构性挑战，以强化跨生物群落的生态保护与社会公平。与拉美基准国家的明确对比表明：不同于哥斯达黎加的中央集权式国家生态系统服务付费和墨西哥的联邦协调流域计划，巴西政策催生了分散化的市州级项目拼图，这些项目与《森林法》合规要求紧密关联，并频繁采用混合支付（现金与实物）模式，勾勒出独特的区域治理范式。

title: The Productivity Effect of High Involvement Management: Causal Evidence From Germany
title_zh: 高参与管理的生产率效应：来自德国的因果证据
title_primary: 高参与管理的生产率效应：来自德国的因果证据
title_secondary: The Productivity Effect of High Involvement Management: Causal Evidence From Germany
authors: Johannes Lehmann
abstract: This study empirically examines the effects of High Involvement Management ( HIM ) on establishment productivity. To achieve this it draws on a large‐scale panel data set representative of the German economy. The identification strategy exploits the bracketing property of fixed effects and lagged dependent variable models and supplements this with a selection‐on‐observables approach to estimate causal effects. Descriptive evidence indicates that decision makers value the joint implementation of the pillars of HIM ( Knowledge , Power , Information , and Rewards ), as they tend to cluster and factor analysis confirms that the included management practices reflect a single underlying management orientation. The causal analysis reveals significant productivity gains from HIM and each of its four pillars. These effects materialize for HIM adoption, HIM intensification and the presence of a HIM philosophy. While the results are in line with a monotonically increasing effect as additional pillars are adopted, no synergies between the pillars or underlying practices emerge. Finally, the findings reveal no meaningful differences in the effectiveness of HIM across establishment size, sector, knowledge intensity, or innovation strategy, suggesting that its impact is broadly consistent across organizational contexts.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本研究实证检验了高参与管理（HIM）对企业生产率的影响。为此，我们使用了代表德国经济的大规模面板数据集。识别策略利用了固定效应和滞后因变量模型的边界特性，并辅以基于可观测变量的选择方法以估计因果效应。描述性证据表明，决策者重视HIM四大支柱（知识、权力、信息与奖励）的联合实施，因为这些支柱往往呈现聚类特征，且因子分析证实所包含的管理实践反映了一种单一的基础管理导向。因果分析显示，HIM及其四大支柱均能带来显著的生产率提升。这些效应体现在HIM的采纳、强化以及HIM理念的存在上。尽管结果与采纳更多支柱时效应单调递增的规律一致，但各支柱或基础实践之间并未显现协同效应。最后，研究发现HIM的有效性在企业规模、行业、知识密集度或创新战略方面不存在显著差异，表明其影响在不同组织情境中具有广泛一致性。

title: A Welfare Analysis of Policies Impacting Climate Change
title_zh: 气候变化政策的福利分析
title_primary: 气候变化政策的福利分析
title_secondary: A Welfare Analysis of Policies Impacting Climate Change
authors: Robert W. Hahn, Nathaniel Hendren, Robert D. Metcalfe, Ben Sprung-Keyser
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the welfare impacts of 96 climate-related tax and spending policies. We extend and apply the marginal value of public funds (MVPF) framework, most notably providing a new method for incorporating learning-by-doing spillovers. We find subsidies for the production of clean energy (such as wind production tax credits) have higher MVPFs than all other subsidies in our sample, including EV subsidies. Conservation nudges have large MVPFs when targeting regions with dirty grids. Fuel taxes and cap-and-trade policies are highly efficient means of raising revenue. We also construct traditional cost-per-ton estimates and compare and contrast the lessons they provide. (JEL D83, H23, H25, L62, Q42, Q54, Q58)
abstract_zh: 我们研究了96项与气候相关的税收和支出政策的福利影响。我们对公共资金边际价值（MVPF）框架进行了扩展和应用，尤其提出了一种纳入干中学溢出效应的新方法。研究发现，清洁能源生产补贴（如风电生产税收抵免）的MVPF高于样本中所有其他补贴，包括电动汽车补贴。针对电网污染严重地区的节能引导政策具有较高的MVPF。燃油税和总量控制与交易政策是高效的财政收入手段。我们还构建了传统的每吨成本估算，并比较了这些估算所提供的政策启示。（JEL分类号：D83, H23, H25, L62, Q42, Q54, Q58）

title: Shaking giants: tax accounting, profit shifting, and the slow art of challenging the status quo
title_zh: 撼动巨头：税务会计、利润转移与挑战现状的缓慢艺术
title_primary: 撼动巨头：税务会计、利润转移与挑战现状的缓慢艺术
title_secondary: Shaking giants: tax accounting, profit shifting, and the slow art of challenging the status quo
authors: Leslie Robinson
abstract: Challenging long-standing norms is how we, as academics studying matters of taxation, make progress: by consuming, or in some cases, replicating prior studies, and reaffirming—or contradicting—their results. Otherwise our science stagnates and our voices become irrelevant to those in government and the business world who form the economic policies we track and hope to influence. Over the course of seven years attempting to correct a simple misunderstanding of an accounting standard, my colleague and I repeatedly demonstrated how an error in measuring income by jurisdiction had influenced the entire debate about the profit-shifting behavior of multinational firms and their use of tax havens. Through our lengthy and ultimately, we believe, successful challenge to the status quo, we learned several important lessons about academic research as a profession, concerning both the role of the community and the role that each individual in the system plays in the pursuit of truth and insight. Throughout the process, our goal was to enact productive change, not to provoke an argument. In that light, we believe our challenge to the status quo will have two lasting impacts: First, when using datasets that attempt to measure the income by jurisdiction of any multinational firm, researchers will now pay more attention to the underlying accounting methods used in the collection of the data. Second, our time-consuming and oftentimes frustrating experience reveals the importance of cross-disciplinary research and better communication between academic accountants and economists.
abstract_zh: 挑战长期存在的规范，正是我们这些研究税收问题的学者取得进步的方式：通过消化吸收，或在某些情况下复制先前的研究，并重申或反驳其结论。否则，我们的科学将停滞不前，我们的声音对政府及商界中那些制定我们追踪并希望影响的经济政策的人而言，将变得无关紧要。在长达七年的时间里，为了纠正一个对会计准则的简单误解，我和同事反复证明了按司法管辖区衡量收入的一个错误如何影响了关于跨国公司利润转移行为及其利用避税天堂的整个辩论。通过我们漫长且最终我们认为成功地挑战现状的过程，我们学到了关于学术研究这一职业的几个重要教训，涉及社群的作用以及体系中每个个体在追求真理与洞察中所扮演的角色。在整个过程中，我们的目标是推动建设性的变革，而非挑起争端。基于此，我们相信我们对现状的挑战将产生两个持久影响：第一，当使用试图衡量任何跨国公司按司法管辖区收入的数据库时，研究人员现在将更加关注数据收集中所采用的底层会计方法。第二，我们耗时且常常令人沮丧的经历揭示了跨学科研究以及学术会计师与经济学家之间更好沟通的重要性。

title: Training Specificity and Occupational Mobility: Evidence From German Apprenticeships
title_zh: 培训专业性与职业流动性：来自德国学徒制的证据
title_primary: 培训专业性与职业流动性：来自德国学徒制的证据
title_secondary: Training Specificity and Occupational Mobility: Evidence From German Apprenticeships
authors: Dita Eckardt
abstract: Apprenticeships play a key role in enabling successful school‐to‐work transitions in many countries, but in the presence of imperfect information, the specificity of this type of training may entail important costs for those working outside their training fields. I study this issue in one of the most prominent training settings, the German apprenticeship system. Using administrative data and a broad occupational classification, I find that 40% of individuals work in occupations different from their training. I estimate the cost of mismatch using vacancy instruments and extend methodological approaches in high‐dimensional selection settings. Lacking training in one's occupation entails an average wage penalty of 14%, the equivalent of two years of work experience. The penalty increases with the task distance between training and occupation. My findings suggest that retraining is crucial to mitigate the adverse consequences from imperfect information in specialized training settings.
abstract_zh: 学徒制在许多国家促进从学校到工作的顺利过渡中发挥着关键作用，但在信息不完全的情况下，这种培训类型的特定性可能给那些在培训领域之外工作的人带来重大成本。我在最突出的培训体系之一——德国学徒制中研究这一问题。利用行政数据和广泛的职业分类，我发现40%的人所从事的职业与其培训领域不同。我通过职位空缺工具估计了错配成本，并扩展了高维选择情境下的方法论途径。缺乏本职业培训平均导致14%的工资惩罚，相当于两年工作经验的价值。这一惩罚随培训与职业之间任务距离的增加而加剧。我的研究结果表明，再培训对于减轻专业化培训环境中信息不完全带来的不利后果至关重要。

title: The benefits of public transit to households: Evidence from India
title_zh: 公共交通对家庭的好处：来自印度的证据
title_primary: 公共交通对家庭的好处：来自印度的证据
title_secondary: The benefits of public transit to households: Evidence from India
authors: Palak Suri, Maureen Cropper
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We measure benefits to households from Mumbai’s new Metro rail system. We estimate a commute mode choice model to value commute time savings in the short run and a housing choice model to value the improved commuting utility that households experience due to spatial sorting. Aggregate benefits from the Metro rail are over 10 times higher when spatial sorting occurs. In the short run women, college-educated workers, and workers with above median incomes experience higher benefits than their opposites. In the long run, households with lower incomes and assets and less than college education benefit more than their wealthier counterparts.
abstract_zh: 我们衡量了孟买新地铁系统为家庭带来的效益。我们估计了一个通勤方式选择模型，以评估短期内的通勤时间节省价值，以及一个住房选择模型，以评估家庭因空间分选而体验到的通勤效用改善。当发生空间分选时，地铁带来的总效益超过其十倍以上。短期内，女性、受过大学教育的工人以及收入高于中位数的工人所获得的效益高于其对应群体。长期来看，收入较低、资产较少且教育水平低于大学的家庭比更富裕的家庭受益更多。

title: Rainfall shocks and learning outcomes: dynamic persistence and the role of local labour demand
title_zh: 降雨冲击与学习成果：动态持续性及地方劳动力需求的作用
title_primary: 降雨冲击与学习成果：动态持续性及地方劳动力需求的作用
title_secondary: Rainfall shocks and learning outcomes: dynamic persistence and the role of local labour demand
authors: Aparajita Dasgupta, Anahita Karandikar
abstract: We present evidence on the role of local labour markets in driving the persistent and gendered impact of rainfall shocks on learning outcomes in rural India. We find contrasting impacts of rainfall shocks by variation in soil texture, which serves as an exogenous driver of female and children's labour force participation. Strikingly, in non-loamy soil (high female and child labour force participation) areas, exposure to positive shocks in early life is associated with a higher likelihood of dropping out of school and being in a lower grade than is age-appropriate, while effects are considerably attenuated in loamy areas. Furthermore, we examine dynamic complementarities and find that female children in non-loamy areas bear the highest learning losses from a positive rainfall shock in their school-going years, especially when they have faced positive shocks in early life. We investigate potential mechanisms by studying children's labour market response under rainfall shocks, and show that the gains or losses in learning outcomes are systematic to local labour market conditions, which influence the opportunity cost of schooling under shocks.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于地方劳动力市场在印度农村地区降雨冲击对学习成果产生持久且具有性别差异影响中所起作用的证据。我们发现，降雨冲击的影响因土壤质地不同而呈现对比性结果，而土壤质地作为女性和儿童劳动力参与的外生驱动因素。引人注目的是，在非壤土（女性和儿童劳动力参与率高）地区，早年经历正向冲击与辍学可能性增加及年级低于适龄水平相关，而在壤土地区，这些影响则显著减弱。此外，我们考察了动态互补性，发现非壤土地区的女童在学龄期遭遇正向降雨冲击时承受最大的学习损失，尤其是当她们在早年也经历过正向冲击时。我们通过研究降雨冲击下儿童的劳动力市场反应来探究潜在机制，并表明学习成果的得失与地方劳动力市场条件系统相关，这些条件在冲击下影响上学的机会成本。

title: Exploring land cover change patterns in Hyrcanian forests through spatiotemporal trend analysis (2000–2022)
title_zh: 基于时空趋势分析（2000–2022年）的希尔卡尼森林土地覆盖变化模式研究
title_primary: 基于时空趋势分析（2000–2022年）的希尔卡尼森林土地覆盖变化模式研究
title_secondary: Exploring land cover change patterns in Hyrcanian forests through spatiotemporal trend analysis (2000–2022)
authors: Qadir Ashournejad, Fateme Garshasbi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Forests play a crucial role in maintaining environmental balance by providing a wide range of valuable ecosystem services. Monitoring their change dynamics is increasingly important for planning, decision-making, and especially for evaluating conservation policies. Due to the significance of this issue, the number of studies examining global forests in terms of change trends is not uniform. The Hyrcanian forests, recognized as one of the most important temperate forests in the world and listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site since 2019, serve as a notable example. The study of their change trends, particularly in light of recent conservation policies, has gained increasing importance. This study aims to analyze the spatial-temporal change trends of the Hyrcanian forests from 2000 to 2022 using remote sensing products. To assess the intensity and direction of changes, Sen’s slope and Mann-Kendall tests were employed. The results indicate 78,609.51 ha of degradation and 85,579.15 ha of deforestation during the study period in this region. Meanwhile, the forest restoration effort has only covered 45,525.90 ha, emphasizing the imbalance between deforestation and restoration. Deforestation is primarily driven by the expansion of agricultural lands, accounting for 79.45% of the total changes. Impervious surfaces and shrublands follow with 7.66% and 5.67%, respectively. In contrast, forest restoration has mostly occurred through the conversion of agricultural land into forests, with agricultural land contributing 74.26% to this process. Grasslands and shrublands follow with 8.14% and 7.65%, respectively. The economic analysis also revealed that deforestation has led to a loss of $1.033 billion in ecosystem service value from the Hyrcanian forests. Among the major policies, the implementation of the forest rest plan in 2016 and the inclusion of the Hyrcanian forests in the UNESCO World Heritage List in 2019 have played a significant role in mitigating forest degradation. Prior to these policies, forest degradation in some years reached approximately 4000 ha, but following their implementation, it was reduced to around 1500 ha. Additionally projections for 2030, 2040, and 2046 show that, without continued protective policies, the forest area could decrease by up to 64,340 ha by 2046, while with the continuation of policies, the forest area could increase by up to 28,554 ha. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of conservation policies and emphasize the necessity for their continuation and strengthening, along with revising land management practices, planning for ecosystem restoration, and ensuring the sustainable use of natural resources.
abstract_zh: 森林在维持环境平衡中发挥着至关重要的作用，提供了多种宝贵的生态系统服务。监测其变化动态对于规划、决策以及特别是评估保护政策日益重要。鉴于这一问题的重要性，关于全球森林变化趋势的研究数量并不均衡。希尔卡尼森林被公认为世界上最重要的温带森林之一，并自2019年起被列入联合国教科文组织世界遗产名录，是一个显著的例子。对其变化趋势的研究，尤其是在近期保护政策背景下，日益受到重视。本研究旨在利用遥感产品分析2000年至2022年间希尔卡尼森林的时空变化趋势。为评估变化的强度和方向，采用了Sen斜率和Mann-Kendall检验。结果表明，研究期间该区域发生了78，609.51公顷的退化和85，579.15公顷的毁林。与此同时，森林恢复工作仅覆盖了45，525.90公顷，凸显了毁林与恢复之间的不平衡。毁林主要由农业用地扩张驱动，占总变化的79.45%。不透水面和灌木地紧随其后，分别占7.66%和5.67%。相比之下，森林恢复主要通过农业用地向森林的转化实现，农业用地对这一过程的贡献率为74.26%。草地和灌木地紧随其后，分别占8.14%和7.65%。经济分析还揭示，毁林已导致希尔卡尼森林生态系统服务价值损失10.33亿美元。在主要政策中，2016年实施的森林休养计划和2019年希尔卡尼森林被列入联合国教科文组织世界遗产名录，在减缓森林退化方面发挥了重要作用。在这些政策实施之前，某些年份的森林退化面积约为4000公顷，而政策实施后减少至约1500公顷。此外，对2030年、2040年和2046年的预测显示，若无持续的保护政策，到2046年森林面积可能减少多达64，340公顷；而若政策得以延续，森林面积可能增加多达28，554公顷。这些发现证明了保护政策的有效性，并强调了继续和加强这些政策的必要性，同时还需修订土地管理实践、规划生态系统恢复，并确保自然资源的可持续利用。

title: Paying £1(£5) or nothing in dictator games: unexpected differences
title_zh: 独裁者游戏中支付1英镑（5英镑）与零支付的意外差异
title_primary: 独裁者游戏中支付1英镑（5英镑）与零支付的意外差异
title_secondary: Paying £1(£5) or nothing in dictator games: unexpected differences
authors: Pablo Brañas-Garza, Antonio M. Espín, Diego Jorrat
abstract: We conducted an online Dictator Game experiment ( N = 1195) to test three hypotheses about the role of monetary incentives in prosocial behavior. First, we examined whether real incentives of £1 reduce the dispersion of responses compared to hypothetical ones. Surprisingly, we found the opposite: hypothetical responses were less dispersed, with choices clustering around the egalitarian split. This pattern held in a replication ( N = 308) with higher stakes (£5), offering no support for the first hypothesis. Second, we tested whether real incentives—by involving actual monetary consequences—lead to more selfish decisions, as they are expected to reduce socially desirable responses. With £1 stakes, no significant differences emerged across conditions. However, when the stake was increased to £5, participants became more selfish under real incentives, supporting the second hypothesis only when the amount at stake is substantial. Third, we explored whether probabilistic payments trigger differential behavior. At low stakes, probabilistic incentives resembled real ones. But with higher stakes, real and probabilistic outcomes diverged, suggesting participants respond to expected value only when it is meaningful. Finally, in a separate study ( N = 299), we found that many participants facing standard hypothetical-payment instructions still expected real payments. Only explicit phrasing stating that “unfortunately, the money is not real” alleviated this confusion. This result underscores the importance of precise wording in experimental design and potentially explains why hypothetical treatments do not yield dramatically different results compared to real-money treatments.
abstract_zh: 我们开展了一项在线独裁者博弈实验（样本量N=1195），以检验关于货币激励在亲社会行为中作用的三个假设。首先，我们考察了与假设性激励相比，1英镑的真实激励是否会降低反应离散度。令人意外的是，我们发现了相反的结果：假设性情境下的反应离散度更低，选择集中在平等主义分配方案附近。这一模式在更高赌注（5英镑）的重复实验（样本量N=308）中得以保持，因此第一个假设未获支持。其次，我们检验了真实激励——通过涉及实际货币后果——是否会导致更自私的决策，因为预期这会减少社会期望性反应。在1英镑赌注下，各条件之间未出现显著差异。然而，当赌注增至5英镑时，参与者在真实激励下变得更加自私，这仅在赌注金额较大时支持了第二个假设。第三，我们探讨了概率性支付是否会引发差异化行为。在低赌注下，概率性激励与真实激励相似。但在高赌注下，真实与概率性结果出现分化，表明参与者仅在有意义的预期价值下才会做出反应。最后，在另一项独立研究（样本量N=299）中，我们发现许多面对标准假设性支付说明的参与者仍预期会获得真实支付。只有明确表述“遗憾的是，这笔钱并非真实”才能缓解这种混淆。这一结果凸显了实验设计中措辞精确的重要性，并可能解释为何假设性处理与真实货币处理相比不会产生显著不同的结果。

title: Why Is Exclusivity in Broadcasting Rights Prevalent and Why Does Simple Regulation Fail?
title_zh: 为何广播权排他性普遍存在且简单监管为何失效？
title_primary: 为何广播权排他性普遍存在且简单监管为何失效？
title_secondary: Why Is Exclusivity in Broadcasting Rights Prevalent and Why Does Simple Regulation Fail?
authors: David Martimort, Jerome Pouyet
abstract: Pay-TV firms compete both downstream to attract viewers and upstream to acquire broadcasting rights. Because profits inherited from downstream competition satisfy a convexity property, allocating rights to the dominant firm maximizes the industry profit. Such an exclusive allocation of rights emerges as a robust equilibrium outcome but may fail to maximize welfare. We analyze whether a ban on resale and a ban on package bidding may improve welfare. These corrective policies have no impact on the final allocation but lead to profit redistribution along the value chain.
abstract_zh: 付费电视企业在下游争夺观众，同时在上游竞争获取转播权。由于下游竞争所继承的利润满足凸性性质，将转播权分配给主导企业可实现行业利润最大化。这种排他性的转播权分配作为稳健的均衡结果出现，但可能无法实现福利最大化。我们分析禁止转售和禁止组合投标是否能改善福利。这些矫正性政策对最终分配没有影响，但会导致价值链上的利润再分配。

title: Unpacking the Farmland Capitalization Effect of Ethanol Establishment
title_zh: 乙醇设施对农地资本化效应的解析
title_primary: 乙醇设施对农地资本化效应的解析
title_secondary: Unpacking the Farmland Capitalization Effect of Ethanol Establishment
authors: Gabriel S. Sampson, Jisang Yu
abstract: We unpack the impact of expansions in ethanol production—as measured by proximity to newly constructed ethanol plants and capacity expansions—on farmland values using land transaction data from Kansas in combination with modern causal inference techniques. We first show that Two‐Way Fixed Effects (TWFE) estimation with data aggregated to the county and township level leads to an average land value effect ranging from 4% to 9% for parcels located within 50 km of an ethanol plant. However, using a modern difference‐in‐difference estimator, we find no evidence of a statistically significant effect on farmland values. Furthermore, our analysis reveals no indication that land value proximity premiums rose following the 2005 Energy Policy Act. We find evidence that the average treatment effect detected by conventional TWFE is largely driven by land transactions in the proximity of ethanol plants that were established prior to the 2005 Energy Policy Act. Proximity to ethanol plants established after the 2005 Energy Policy Act has a smaller and less robust effect on land values.
abstract_zh: 我们利用堪萨斯州的土地交易数据，结合现代因果推断技术，揭示了乙醇产量扩张（以新建乙醇工厂及产能扩张的邻近程度衡量）对农田价值的影响。首先，将数据汇总至县和乡镇层面后，采用双向固定效应（TWFE）估计发现，位于乙醇工厂50公里范围内的地块，其土地价值平均影响幅度在4%至9%之间。然而，使用现代双重差分估计器后，我们未发现乙醇工厂对农田价值具有统计上显著影响的证据。此外，分析表明，2005年《能源政策法案》实施后，土地价值并未因邻近乙醇工厂而出现溢价上升的迹象。我们找到证据表明，传统TWFE方法检测到的平均处理效应主要源于2005年《能源政策法案》之前已建立的乙醇工厂周边土地交易。而2005年《能源政策法案》之后建立的乙醇工厂，其邻近性对土地价值的影响较小且稳健性较弱。

title: Inflation targeting and income inequality
title_zh: 通胀目标制与收入不平等
title_primary: 通胀目标制与收入不平等
title_secondary: Inflation targeting and income inequality
authors: Hippolyte Balima, Alexandru Minea, Cezara Vinturis
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We investigate the effect of inflation targeting on income inequality across a comprehensive panel of 152 countries spanning over four decades. Using the entropy balancing methodology to address endogeneity issues, we find that inflation targeting significantly increases income inequality. This effect, which is robust across various alternative methods and specifications, is driven by an increase (decrease) in the income share of relatively rich (poor) households. In addition, the impact of inflation targeting is not uniform but varies conditional on redistribution policies, inflation targeting features, the level of economic development, and country-specific characteristics. Our findings contribute to the ongoing discussion on the broad socioeconomic implications of the monetary policy, including measures to mitigate the potential side effects on income distribution.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了通货膨胀目标制对收入不平等的影响，基于一个覆盖152个国家、跨越四十多年的全面面板数据。采用熵平衡方法以解决内生性问题，我们发现通货膨胀目标制显著加剧了收入不平等。这一效应在多种替代方法和规格下均保持稳健，其驱动因素在于相对富裕（贫困）家庭收入份额的增加（减少）。此外，通货膨胀目标制的影响并非均匀一致，而是根据再分配政策、通货膨胀目标制的特征、经济发展水平以及国家特定特征而有所差异。我们的发现为关于货币政策广泛社会经济影响的持续讨论做出了贡献，包括采取措施以减轻其对收入分配潜在副作用的策略。

title: Consumer Mobility, Offline and Online Regional Trade: Evidence From High‐Frequency Transaction Data
title_zh: 消费者流动性、线下与线上区域贸易：来自高频交易数据的证据
title_primary: 消费者流动性、线下与线上区域贸易：来自高频交易数据的证据
title_secondary: Consumer Mobility, Offline and Online Regional Trade: Evidence From High‐Frequency Transaction Data
authors: David Bounie, Youssouf Camara, John W. Galbraith
abstract: The shift from offline to online purchasing is reshaping trade patterns: a weaker effect of distance has been observed in digital transactions. This study analyzes these dynamics at an unprecedented scale and granularity, using interregional gravity models estimated from billions of geolocated French card transactions. Using a matched sample of merchants active in both online and offline channels, with unambiguous regional identification, we compare purchasing behavior across channels. We estimate that distance matters 35% less online than offline on average, but for durables, 69% lower online; 43% lower online for nondurables; a negligible online–offline difference is found for services.
abstract_zh: 从线下购物向线上购物的转变正在重塑贸易格局：数字交易中距离的影响有所减弱。本研究利用数十亿条地理定位的法国银行卡交易数据，通过区域间引力模型，在前所未有的规模和粒度上分析了这些动态变化。采用同时活跃于线上和线下渠道的商户匹配样本，并确保区域识别无误，我们比较了不同渠道的购买行为。估计结果显示，平均而言，线上交易中距离的影响比线下低35%，但耐用品线上低69%；非耐用品线上低43%；而服务业的线上与线下差异则可忽略不计。

title: Global agricultural value chains and food prices
title_zh: 全球农业价值链与粮食价格
title_primary: 全球农业价值链与粮食价格
title_secondary: Global agricultural value chains and food prices
authors: Bernhard Dalheimer, Marc F. Bellemare
abstract: We study the relationship between the extent of participation in global agricultural value chains (GAVCs) and food prices at the country level. Using longitudinal data on a sample of 138 countries for the period 2000–2015 and a shift-share instrumental variable design, we study how the extent of a country's participation in GAVCs in a given year relates to food price levels and volatility in that same country and in the same year. We document a mean–variance trade-off, finding that on average, participation in GAVCs is associated with a decrease in consumer food price levels but an increase in food price volatility. Looking at a country's upstream (i.e., closer to producers) or downstream (i.e., closer to consumers) positioning in GAVCs, we find that food price volatility is associated more strongly with downstream participation than with upstream participation.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了全球农业价值链（GAVCs）参与程度与国家层面食品价格之间的关系。利用2000年至2015年间138个国家的纵向数据，并采用移位份额工具变量设计，我们考察了一个国家在特定年份参与GAVCs的程度如何与该国同年度的食品价格水平及波动性相关联。我们记录了一种均值-方差权衡，发现平均而言，参与GAVCs与消费者食品价格水平下降相关，但同时也与食品价格波动性增加相关。考察一国在GAVCs中的上游（即更接近生产者）或下游（即更接近消费者）定位时，我们发现食品价格波动性与下游参与的关系强于上游参与。

title: Global Factors in Noncore Bank Funding and Exchange Rate Flexibility
title_zh: 非核心银行融资中的全球因素与汇率弹性
title_primary: 非核心银行融资中的全球因素与汇率弹性
title_secondary: Global Factors in Noncore Bank Funding and Exchange Rate Flexibility
authors: LUÍS A.V. CATÃO, JAN DITZEN, DANIEL MARCEL TE KAAT
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
abstract: We show that fluctuations in the ratio of noncore to core funding in the banking systems of advanced economies are largely driven by three global factors of both real and financial natures, with country‐specific factors playing only a minor role. Exchange rate flexibility helps insulate the noncore to core ratio from such global factors. This insulation is stronger in periods away from global crises. Tighter prudential regulations appear to have a complementary effect to exchange rate insulation.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，发达经济体银行体系中非核心融资与核心融资之比的波动，主要由三个兼具实体与金融性质的全球因素驱动，而国别特定因素的作用甚微。汇率灵活性有助于使非核心与核心之比免受此类全球因素的影响。在全球危机之外的时期，这种隔离效应更为显著。更严格的审慎监管似乎对汇率隔离具有补充作用。

title: Why do pilot free trade zones not enhance productivity? Empirical evidence from a sample of Chinese listed companies
title_zh: 为何自由贸易试验区未能提升生产率？基于中国上市公司样本的实证证据
title_primary: 为何自由贸易试验区未能提升生产率？基于中国上市公司样本的实证证据
title_secondary: Why do pilot free trade zones not enhance productivity? Empirical evidence from a sample of Chinese listed companies
authors: Pei-Hua Zhu Zi-Xuan Kou Kai-Yu Jin Xiang-Hui Meng a College of Economics and Management, Beijing University of Technology, Beijing, Chinab Beijing-Dublin International College, Chinac Research and Development Department, Bank of Beijing, Beijing 等
abstract: Pilot free trade zones (FTZs) constitute crucial reform measures for deepening institutional opening up. However, their microeconomic effects remain debated, and their influence on total factor productivity (TFP) needs further exploration. Using Chinese A-share listed companies as a sample, this study employs a difference-in-differences (DID) model to evaluate the productivity effects of FTZs and to identify the underlying mechanisms. The results indicate that pilot FTZs have a negative effect on enterprise productivity, which is seen primarily in eastern China, private enterprises, and high-tech industries. However, pilot FTZs in first-tier cities can mitigate this negative impact. Regarding the mechanisms, FTZs exacerbate market monopoly power, encourage enterprises to increase their investment scale, and exert a crowding-out effect on innovation. Hence, the mass implementation of institutional opening up via pilot FTZs should not be rushed. Instead, pilot reforms should prioritize developed first-tier cities, and they should balance high levels of openness with innovation-driven growth strategies. These findings offer a foundation for refining FTZ policies and advancing high-quality enterprise development.
abstract_zh: 自由贸易试验区（FTZs）是深化制度型开放的关键改革举措，但其微观经济效应仍存争议，对全要素生产率（TFP）的影响有待深入探究。本研究以中国A股上市公司为样本，采用双重差分（DID）模型评估自贸试验区的生产率效应，并识别其作用机制。结果表明，自贸试验区对企业生产率存在负向影响，这一效应主要集中于东部地区、民营企业和高科技行业。然而，一线城市的自贸试验区能够缓解这种负面冲击。从机制来看，自贸试验区加剧了市场垄断势力，促使企业扩大投资规模，并对创新产生挤出效应。因此，不宜急于通过自贸试验区大规模推行制度型开放，而应优先在发达的一线城市开展试点改革，并平衡高水平开放与创新驱动增长战略。这些发现为完善自贸试验区政策、推动企业高质量发展提供了依据。
